#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Summarize a CSV of build results.

set -euo pipefail

main() {
  local file="${1:-}"

  if [[ -z ${file} ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s FILE\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
    return 64
  fi

  if [[ ! -r ${file} ]]; then
    printf '%s: cannot read %s\n' "${0##*/}" "${file}" >&2
    return 66
  fi

  local total=0 passed=0 failed=0
  local status

  while IFS=, read -r _ status _; do
    if [[ ${status} == 'status' ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    total=$((total + 1))
    case "${status}" in
      pass) passed=$((passed + 1)) ;;
      *) failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done < "${file}"

  printf 'total=%d passed=%d failed=%d\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
}

main "$@"

python3 - <<'E'
p='bin/report.sh'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''  local file="${1:-}"

  if [[ -z ${file} ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s FILE\\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
''','''  local file="" json=0 arg

  for arg in "$@"; do
    case "${arg}" in
      --json) json=1 ;;
      *) [[ -z ${file} ]] && file="${arg}" ;;
    esac
  done

  if [[ -z ${file} ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s [--json] FILE\\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
''')
s=s.replace('''  printf 'total=%d passed=%d failed=%d\\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
''','''  if ((json)); then
    printf '{"total":%d,"passed":%d,"failed":%d}\\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
  else
    printf 'total=%d passed=%d failed=%d\\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
  fi
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cat >> test/report.bats <<'E'

@test "--json prints the counters as JSON" {
  run "${REPO_ROOT}/bin/report.sh" --json "${REPO_ROOT}/data/sample.csv"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$output" = '{"total":3,"passed":2,"failed":1}' ]
}

@test "--json is accepted after the file too" {
  run "${REPO_ROOT}/bin/report.sh" "${REPO_ROOT}/data/sample.csv" --json
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$output" = '{"total":3,"passed":2,"failed":1}' ]
}

@test "--json without a file reports usage" {
  run "${REPO_ROOT}/bin/report.sh" --json
  [ "$status" -eq 64 ]
}

@test "--json with a missing file fails like text mode" {
  run "${REPO_ROOT}/bin/report.sh" --json "${REPO_ROOT}/data/absent.csv"
  [ "$status" -eq 66 ]
}
E
sed -i 's|^`bin/report.sh FILE` summarizes a CSV of build results as one line of counters.|&\nPass `--json` (`bin/report.sh --json FILE`) to get the same counters as a JSON object.|' README.md
make test
